mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline over 3 months, or Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales above their 3-month moving averages indicates strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3-month moving averages, or interaction Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production above 110 in early-cycle expansion signals robust manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of early-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% for two consecutive months signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous non-farm payroll growth and unemployment rate decline indicate labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances with PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline, or interaction Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle labor market tightness (unemployment rate below 4.5% and payroll growth above 0.5% MoM) supports consumer spending and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
